blocks.text: LONDON, United Kingdom — Andy Taylor, the former guitarist for new wave pop group Duran Duran, has died after a “long and courageous battle with prostate cancer,” the band and his family said in a joint Instagram post late Wednesday. He was 65. “Andy passed away peacefully at home, surrounded by his family on Monday, November 23,” they said. Taylor’s rock- and funk-inspired riffs drove the British band’s dance-floor hits such as “Girls on Film” and “Rio,” helping define the sound of the 1980s.
